summary: argenx SE completed its acquisition of Forte Biosciences, Inc. via a cash tender offer and subsequent merger. argenx offered $77.00 per share in cash, with 19,894,879 shares tendered plus owned shares representing approximately 87.13% of Forte's outstanding stock. The deal adds FB102, a first-in-class anti-CD122 antibody, to argenx's immunology pipeline. The merger converted all remaining Forte shares into the right to receive the same $77.00 cash price. The transaction was completed on August 27, 2026, expanding argenx's portfolio and broadening its reach in autoimmune diseases. What to watch: post-merger integration and FB102 development progress.
